note: The Act 1 cast of missions m.a1.01 to m.a1.12 (M05c1, M05c2). Every entry is original and fictionalized: M10c writes the soul.md of each id. A roster slot names the roster soul that plays it once Q-19 and Q-25 supply the roster (rosterSoul is null until then) and an original stand-in that plays it before; the stand-in is also the fallback when the roster soul is killed. Stand-in bodies are creator-kit bodies with a palette variant (DL-180).
